SYMPTOM: n8n MCP server loading unexpectedly across all projects, user couldn't find config in ~/.claude/

CAUSE: Claude Code walks up directory tree looking for .mcp.json files, same as .gitignore pattern. File was at ~/Desktop/.mcp.json — parent of all Desktop projects.

FIX: Deleted ~/Desktop/.mcp.json. Kept project-specific config at ~/Desktop/Projects/n8n/.mcp.json

PREVENT: Only place .mcp.json inside specific project directories, never at Desktop level or higher. Global MCP config belongs in ~/.claude/mcpjson/ instead.

NOTE: Other MCP servers (Gmail, Google Calendar, Stitch, XCode) are cloud-managed via Anthropic — not in .mcp.json files. Local ones only.
